descriptionChirho: To flee or run away from danger, pursuit, or an undesirable situation, used across all Qal inflections including perfects, imperfects, imperatives, participles, infinitives, and cohortatives.
To pass through or cross through a space, a distinct Qal usage where the motion is traversal rather than escape.
Causative Hifil stem meaning to cause someone to flee, to chase away, drive out, or put to flight.
Causative Hifil usage meaning to cause something to pass or run through, describing traversal rather than flight.
